correctness.rationale: The star spectral projectors at eigenvalues 0, 1, and m+1 reproduce all four exact transfer-matrix entry formulas. Each denominator is positive; both off-diagonal entry classes have positive polynomial numerators for h>0. The hub quadratic has two positive zeros exactly when integer m>=11. The leaf quartic is positive for m=2..10 by a positive concavity-endpoint certificate, and for m>=11 has exactly two positive simple roots by sign changes, a negative witness at h=m, and positivity at h=3 and infinity. The two forbidden diagonal intervals are disjoint. Pure-Python Fraction verification checks 176 rational full-matrix identities, row sums and signs, without substituting finite tests for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This gives a complete sharp time-step classification for an infinite, naturally parameterized stiffness family. The m=11 onset and two successive, disjoint sign-failure mechanisms produce three admissible positivity bands rather than an ordinary single bound; the safe middle band and large-step restoration matter in deciding whether A-/L-stability can be trusted to preserve physical nonnegativity. The conclusion is more than evaluation of one matrix or a textbook SSP corollary and does not follow from the related h-independent reversible-chain diagonal bound. Its limits are explicit: one unweighted graph family and one completed-step integrator.
